notCanonizedOrRepaired: No confirmed remaining F01–F05 defect is asserted by this documentation pass.

Selector-specific muted/border variations and enabled-hover border cascade remain local source facts, not a newly standardized palette or a confirmed defect. Possible normalization requires separate design review.
Generated OKLCH tonal ramps are synthesized preview metadata; they are not extracted product tokens and may exceed sRGB gamut.

staticExamples.cssScope: All specimen classes ds-prefixed; literal source values because CSS has no custom properties. Noto uses the source system-ui/sans-serif fallback if the host has not registered the self-hosted face.
exceptions: Download link has no href or blob; isolated inline-block adaptation only.
Example input bounds and metadata are clearly synthetic static values.
Scene shell has no scene canvas or subject; selection class is a styling specimen, not a runnable workflow.
Only width-bound field/radio targets expand source border-box; snippets do not ship a universal reset.
